description: Vand i tal (Water in Figures) is the annual statistics and benchmarking publication of the Danish water and wastewater association DANVA, produced from the data that member utilities report to DANVA Benchmarking og Statistik. The 2025 edition (60 pages, data for 2024) gives key figures on drinking water operation and investment, water losses, remote-read meters, water quality, pipe bursts, renewal rates and energy, and on wastewater operation and investment, separate sewering and renewal, energy, nutrient discharges, inflow factor and sludge, plus water prices, debt, emergency preparedness and greenhouse gas emissions. Coverage is Denmark: 78 drinking water and 91 wastewater utilities reported for the 2025 edition, supplying about 60% of the population with drinking water and handling wastewater from more than 90%. The publication is free in PDF and online, with an English edition; the underlying statistics and benchmarking products are for DANVA members only (login), and no licence is stated. Caveats: participation is by DANVA members and is not complete, and the free publication gives sector key figures, not a full per-utility table. Simulation uses: national pipe burst rates, water losses, renewal rates and sewer separation for capacity planning, resilience and climate adaptation of water networks. Related records: the Australian national performance report for urban water (data-bom-national-performance-report-urban-water).
